title: Necessity and Sufficiency for Explaining Text Classifiers: A Case Study in Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating necessity and sufficiency feature attribution scores for gender identity terms (e.g., 'women') using a generative mask-and-infill perturbation model, and analyzing the correlation of these scores with model false-positive rates on neutral or supportive statements from the HateCheck dataset.

Calculating necessity and sufficiency feature attribution scores for religious identity terms (e.g., 'Muslims') using a generative mask-and-infill perturbation model, and analyzing the correlation of these scores with model false-positive rates on neutral or supportive statements from the HateCheck dataset.
